title: 手写两层全连接网络的前向传播（无框架）
code:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(0)

def relu(x):
    return np.maximum(0, x)

def linear(x, W, b):
    return x @ W + b

# 网络：input 3 -> hidden 4 -> output 2
D, H, C = 3, 4, 2
W1 = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (D, H))
b1 = np.zeros(H)
W2 = rng.normal(0, 0.1, (H, C))
b2 = np.zeros(C)

X = np.array([[1.0, 2.0, 3.0],
              [-1.0, 0.5, 0.0]], dtype=np.float64)

z1 = linear(X, W1, b1)
h1 = relu(z1)
logits = linear(h1, W2, b2)

print("输入 X shape:", X.shape)
print()
print("第1层线性 z1 = X@W1 + b1,  shape:", z1.shape)
print(np.round(z1, 4))
print()
print("ReLU 激活后 h1, shape:", h1.shape)
print(np.round(h1, 4))
print("  被置零的元素数:", int((h1 == 0).sum()), "/", h1.size,
      "  <- ReLU 的稀疏性")
print()
print("输出层 logits shape:", logits.shape)
print(np.round(logits, 4))
print()
print("=== 为什么必须有激活函数 ===")
# 若去掉 relu，两层线性复合等价于一层
W_combined = W1 @ W2
direct = X @ W_combined + (b1 @ W2 + b2)
no_act = linear(linear(X, W1, b1), W2, b2)
print("去掉 ReLU 后，两层等价于一层线性变换:")
print("  差异最大值 =", float(np.max(np.abs(no_act - direct))), " (应≈0)")
print("  结论：线性变换的复合仍是线性变换，多层无激活 = 单层，表达能力不随深度增长。")
